question: A 275-metre-long train crosses a platform thrice its length in 44 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?3714
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 275 m

Length of platform = 3 × 275 m = 825 m

Total distance = 275 m + 825 m = 1100 m

Time = 44 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed (km/hr) = Speed (m/s) × 18 ÷ 5

**Calculation:**

⇒ Speed (m/s) = 1100 ÷ 44 = 25 m/s

⇒ Speed (km/hr) = 25 × 18 ÷ 5 = 90 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**
